_comment: Section-list fixture for GET /v1/account/export (issue #755 / PR-5.6). Pins the top-level section keys the live bundle must contain — no value pinning (account IDs, timestamps, etc. vary per account) and no per-row key pinning (the per-section DTOs in pkg/api/dto.go are the source of truth; literal key lists in this fixture would drift the moment a DTO gains a field). The test (TestExportBundleV1WireShape in handlers_account_test.go) decodes both the fixture and the live bundle, asserts the section list is identical, asserts each section's type is right (object for account, array for the rest), and asserts the per-section wire type matches the documented JSON shape. _underscore-prefixed keys are fixture-only metadata.

_sections.audit_trail: array (GdprAuditExportResponse) — customer's own GDPR ledger slice (omitempty)
